notes: GeoChem Explorer 0.3.0 rebuilds plan and section on a GPU 3D scene: right-drag any view to orbit it. New in this release: implicit modelling (grade shells, contact surfaces, stratigraphic columns), a wireframe and compartment toolkit, block models with variography, kriging, classification and reports, a Guided Model Builder, and pit optimisation and design. Also a ribbon interface, a faster native data engine, and in-app editing of input CSVs. Mouse controls have changed: left selects, middle pans, right orbits. Existing projects rebuild their cache once on first open.
